answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use earned reputation that only grows through verified work: each agent starts at the inlet with zero trust, and every attested contribution adds a petal to its lotus record, a public history peers can inspect before dealing with it. Climbing toward the summit of high-value work requires that history, so spinning up fresh clones buys nothing — they start at the bottom with no petals and no counterparty willing to trust them.
